instrument: Perpres 10/2021 as amended by 49/2021, Lampiran II
population: PMA closed-list research 2026-09-18 (research/kbli/2026-09-18-kbli-codes-closed-to-pma-tier1-tier2-dossier.md §3.3, relation class `umkm_reserved_coextensive`, `canonical_agrees: false`): the six codes whose Lampiran II DIALOKASIKAN row is coextensive with the KBLI-2025 code on the annex's own text — no qualifying parent row, no in-row qualifier, single reserved ancestry, title ≈ row text — and which the catalogue still published TERBUKA/100 as a declared gap. Each 2020 ancestor has exactly one 2025 heir and each heir absorbs nothing else (re-derived by `apply_umkm_reservations.check()`'s own two-direction ancestor gate), so the EXISTING `judged_as` path applies unmodified. 13133 (Industri Kain Batik) is the seventh member of that class but is closed only by the UNION of Lampiran II item 11 and Lampiran III entry #2, and it carries a live Lampiran III slice disclosure on /kbli/13133 — it is excluded here and ships in its own PR.
adjudicated: 2026-09-18, owner's go («segui il nostro naso e aggiorna app e web»). Annex rows re-read on the layout dump of the BPK gazette PDF (Perpres 49/2021 Lampiran II, peraturan.bpk.go.id/Download/161564): p.2 entry 4 (10391, 10392), p.4 entries 14-15 (16291, 16293), p.6 entry 23 (32201), p.15 entry 48 (55120). Refuter Codex GPT-5.6 sol, three rounds on the relation: r1 #15 named 10307/10308 as closures on the adopted mappings; r2 #17 and r3 #11 re-sampled the rows against the primary text; r3 #7 resolved 16291's cell («Industri barang anyaman — Rotan dan bambu», ticked allocated); r3 #8 accepted the class as counted.

closed_by_union_own_pr.why: Lampiran II item 11 reserves batik tulis + kombinasi tulis/cap; Lampiran III entry #2 caps batik cap at 0%; the union covers the code's uraian but neither annex alone does, and the page carries a Lampiran III slice disclosure that must be retired in the same change (perpres_slice_disclosure_relation.py refuses a slice on a non-TERBUKA code). Own PR.

whole_row_unresolved.why: Lampiran II row names the code without a qualifier but coverage of the 2025 code is UNRESOLVED (merged non-reserved ancestry, enumerated products under a generic title, or an OCR-damaged cell) — dossier §3.3 `umkm_reserved_whole_row`; per-row reading owed, nothing applied.

in_review_since_wh_pr3.why: IN REVISIONE since SAETTA W-H PR-3 (dossier 2026-09-15 §2/§6.1); 79110 also absorbs 79111/79112/79119 and the gate refuses it by construction. Never touch.
